The '''Council Dwelling''' was the place of meeting for the [[Citizen's Council of Dodz]] on [[Dodz]] circa [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. It was attacked by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kugg]], who had one of the structure's walls ripped open.
